corrections.sourceSupportedCause: The dialog and its local state were emitted inside a disposable LazyColumn item. IME changes can remeasure the profile viewport and remove that item. The old artifact does not contain a lifecycle trace, so item disposal is a source-supported cause, not a separately recorded lifecycle event.
corrections.fix: Hoist the modal outside the lazy list; scope-key open state, key draft/search composition to the owner, and reject Apply if the current model owner differs. Keep per-open saved draft/search, cancel semantics, distinct country values, and the 30-item limit including repeated callbacks.

corrections.sourceSupportedCause: Exact Compose 1.9.4 plain-String Text draws an intrinsic-width Paragraph. Its GetTextLayoutResult reconstructs a MultiParagraph with available maxWidth but returns the original smaller layoutSize; didOverflowWidth compares these different widths. This establishes a semantic measurement mismatch for short intrinsic-width notes. The old log lacks width/height metrics and does not prove visible glyph clipping.
corrections.fix: Use the full card content width for the note, matching rendered and accessibility layout constraints without weakening overflow or last-line assertions.
